name: Idaho Supreme Potatoes Inc.
old_description: Idaho Pacific Holdings, Inc. is a family of potato dehydration companies spanning North America – from the nutrient rich farmlands of Idaho to the San Luis Valley of Colorado to the red sandy soils of Prince Edward Island, Canada.
about:
Idaho Supreme Potatoes operates from Firth, Idaho, where it began as a fresh potato packing operation in 1967. The facility expanded into potato dehydration in 1969 and grew into one of North America's leading dehydration plants. In 2018, Idaho Pacific Holdings acquired the company and continues its tradition of supplying dehydrated potato products worldwide.

The plant produces dehydrated potato flakes, flour, slices, dices, and shreds or hash browns, with ingredient specifications ranging from whole flake to finely milled flours, full cook to low leach, and additive-free clean label options. Foodservice lines include complete mashed potato mixes (blended or agglomerated), scalloped and au gratin casseroles, and seasoned or unseasoned hash browns. An in-house R&D team develops custom formulations, while packaging runs cover poly pouches, gabled cartons, #10 tins, kraft bags, polyethylene bulk sacks, and bulk rail or truck shipments. Private labeling is available for most foodservice and retail items.

Customers span foodservice distributors, retail brands, and industrial ingredient users across North America. The company sources Russet varieties such as Burbank, Norkotah, and Ranger from Idaho's Snake River Plain, leveraging the region's soil, water, and climate for consistent year-round supply.

Idaho Supreme Potatoes emphasizes its diverse production capabilities and certifications—GFSI, Orthodox Union kosher, and IFANCA halal—as the foundation for meeting varied technical and regulatory requirements.
